limitations: GitHub (and every app toolkit) needs a connected account; none was connected, so no app tool (e.g. GITHUB_GET_A_REPOSITORY) was executed. Only the Composio meta tool COMPOSIO_GET_TOOL_SCHEMAS was executed.
A Composio toolkit existing does not prove the vendor API is self-serve: Composio may use managed/partner credentials. Official docs remain primary evidence.
Catalog auth_schemes describe what Composio implements, not every method the vendor supports; 'agree' means Composio's schemes are a subset of what the crawler found.
Catalog matching is name/slug/domain based; 3 wrong-product matches were rejected by human review, and 'medium'/'weak' matches are labelled.
Composio was not used for web search or browsing; documentation research is done by the project's own crawler.
